rationale: No remaining lever value can plausibly pass the gate (latency <535ms, or quality >0.5455, with premature_transfers <=12). Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite gives the same output on every run: all 74 failures repeated across r1/r2/r3, and temperature 0.0 (round 6) scored the same as the baseline. So temperature 0.7 can only stay the same or add premature transfers, and a lower token cap doesn't affect first-action latency but risks cutting off tool calls or scripted closings. The gateway route is slower. GPT-5.4-mini, Qwen3-Next and Llama-4-Maverick all scored speak_and_act=0 and quality 0.33-0.40, so GPT-5.4-nano (same family as mini) and Llama-3.1-8B would almost certainly regress quality, and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (more active parameters than Qwen3-Next at 1192ms) is unlikely to beat 535ms. DeepSeek-v4.1-flash (0.538, 6 premature transfers) fails only on +89ms latency, and no lever cuts latency enough to offset that. For the user: DeepSeek is the only option that halves premature transfers; whether to trade about 90ms of latency for that is a policy decision outside this gate.
